after.zh: 任何一个框都能换成 K、S 和套用，这叫<wiki-ref to="deduction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Any box can be traded for K, S and Apply: the <wiki-ref to="deduction"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 有框时，证明是什么样子？框里的每一步，没有框时由谁来做？
hint.en: What does the proof look like with a box? Without one, what does each step inside it?

hint.zh: 框里的套用是在条件「下雨」下做的。
hint.en: The Apply inside the box happens under the condition “it rains”.
